name: Everything_4
short_caption: Pepper sweeps both arms outward with open palms to express a broad or comprehensive concept.
movement_description: The robot starts from its neutral resting pose and brings both hands inward toward the center of its chest, with wrists slightly bent and fingers open. It then smoothly extends both arms outward and slightly downward to the sides, presenting open palms facing forward and upward in a welcoming gesture. After holding this expansive posture briefly, the robot smoothly retracts its arms back to the neutral resting position at its sides.
safety_notes: The arms sweep outward to the sides, requiring moderate lateral clearance around the robot.
